title: pertEvalR: calibrated, signal-aware evaluation of single-cell perturbation response predictions in R
description: pertEvalR evaluates models that predict transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations from single-cell screens. It diagnoses the signal in a dataset (systematic variation, split-half reliability), provides leakage-free splits and reference baselines, scores predictions per perturbation, compares methods with paired bootstrap intervals and signed-rank tests, calibrates scores between an uninformative lower bound and a technical-replicate upper bound, and restricts evaluation to reliably measured perturbations. This archive contains the R package source and the analysis scripts that reproduce all figures of the accompanying manuscript.
